==Usage==
===Externals links===
<code><nowiki>{{DeviantArt|username=|name=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

'''Parameters'''
*{{Para|username}} Part of the url of the profile page, excluding the <code>https://www.deviantart.com/</code> portion.
*{{Para|name}} Complete name of the artist.

===References===
<code><nowiki>{{DeviantArt|username=|url=|name=|text=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

'''Required parameters'''
*{{Para|username}} Part of the url of the profile page, excluding the <code>https://www.deviantart.com/</code> portion.
*{{Para|url}} URL of the page, excluding the <code>https://www.deviantart.com/</code> portion.
*{{Para|name}} Complete name of the artist. Must be linked to their Wookieepedia article.
*{{Para|text}} Title of the page.

'''Optional parameters'''
*{{Para|date}} Date the DeviantArt post was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} A short excerpt from the citation for quick reference in the article.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Example(s)===
For references:

<code><nowiki>{{DeviantArt|username=brenze|url=brenze/art/Electronic-Games-Monthly-cover-147093401|name=[[Brian Menze]]|text=Electronic Games Monthly cover|date=2009-12-18|quote=This was my first time ever doing a cover for a magazine. I loved the experience. The bonus is that I was asked to paint Darth Nihilus, my favorite among all the characters I concepted for Knights of the Old Republic II.|archivedate=20210127025403}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{DeviantArt|username=brenze|url=brenze/art/Electronic-Games-Monthly-cover-147093401|name=[[Brian Menze]]|text=Electronic Games Monthly cover|date=2009-12-18|quote=This was my first time ever doing a cover for a magazine. I loved the experience. The bonus is that I was asked to paint Darth Nihilus, my favorite among all the characters I concepted for Knights of the Old Republic II.|archivedate=20210127025403}}

<hr/>
For External links:

<code><nowiki>{{DeviantArt|username=brenze|name=Brian Menze}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{DeviantArt|username=brenze|name=Brian Menze}}
